text:
alex (partnerships): Quick kickoff — YYC (Calgary) private VPC + AWS Marketplace SKU onboarding. Need capacity, quotas, KMS binding, and joint announcement timeline. @kevin-hw can you confirm GPU availability?
kevin-hw (partner-ops): We can provision A100 L4 nodes in YYC by week of Jul 7. Initial reservation 4 nodes (can scale). Need warranty/legal addendum for rack-level support. :thumbsup:
omar (cloudops): I'll open quota + marketplace entitlement tickets with AWS today. Need SKU names and approximate qps/throughput numbers. Any expected concurrency? 
sophie (sales): Customer asked for private VPC + dedicated throughput SLA (99.9%). Wants GA + co-marketing. Preferred launch window early Aug. Will coordinate PR if partners OK.
rita (legal): For private VPC + KMS, we need the KMS integration clause + DPA/HIPAA check. I'll draft a short addendum. If partner logos used in PR, we need logo rights clearance.
deploy-bot: Created ticket CT-5923: aws-marketplace-entitlement-yyc and CT-5924: quota-request-yyc
alex (partnerships): Action items: - @kevin-hw: confirm node types, qty, serials + support SLA - @omar: submit AWS entitlement & quota (attach expected token usage) - @rita: draft KMS/DPA addendum - @sophie: draft PR outline and go/no-go checklist
kevin-hw (partner-ops): Confirmed: 4x A100-L4, 2TB NVMe local scratch, will supply firmware matrix. Support SLA available for add-on. I'll upload BOM to drive link: https://rwd.link/yyc-bom
omar (cloudops): Opening entitlement request now. Placeholder payload:
```
{ "sku": "redwood-yyc-a100-l4-dedicated", "initial_units": 4, "region": "ca-central-2", "kms_required": true }
```
I'll update CT-5923 with real numbers.
sophie (sales): Will build a one-pager for the partner go-to-market and propose joint announcement timeline. Tentative GA: 2025-08-01. 
rita (legal): Draft ready for review in #legal-drafts, pinging @kevin-hw for partner signature block.
alex (partnerships): Thanks team. Weekly sync Thursdays 10am PT until GA. Next: Omar & Kevin to surface any blocker by EOD Fri. :calendar:
kevin-hw (partner-ops): Understood — will confirm serials + SLA doc by Friday.
